svg.title: FlashAttention and FlashAttention-2: work partitioning between warps
svg.desc: Two panels retain the reference layout. Left: Q is accessed by all four warps, while K transpose is split into four column slices and V into four corresponding row slices. Right: Q is split into four row slices, while K transpose and V are accessed by all four warps. Blue dotted blocks mean shared access; orange dashed blocks mean slices assigned to different warps.
